lastText: The Night EndsThe Last SunsetNew Ending Discovered · 1 / 15TWO MEN KILL A NOBLEMAN ON A WAGONYou are in your box on a wagon on a road in the mountains, at the end of a clear day. Five men come over the ridge, but the young solicitor is not one of them, because you did not let him come home. A tall American has a bowie knife and a young lord has a hatchet. They do it between them, quickly, with very little ceremony. Then the earth is over you, and you are dust. There is nobody to write it down. The tellings differ, but they agree on one thing: that whatever he did, he did it in a great hurry, as if he were afraid there would not be enough time. People remember that he wept. A girl from the village says that she saw him, on the night of the storm, standing on the cliff with his hands over his face.
